_comment: Tier-2 SYNTHETIC (stokes::98, an index no pitfall occupies): ufl.FiniteElement, VectorElement, MixedElement and TensorElement are gone from ufl and basix.ufl replaces them. RE-KEYED 2026-08-06 off stokes::1, which is the enclosed-flow pressure-nullspace claim and has nothing to do with element classes. No pitfall in the current fenics inventory states the element-class removal — the nearest, reaction_diffusion::0, is about mixed_element's argument list and is covered elsewhere — so this fixture is real evidence for no listed claim and is keyed synthetically rather than parked on a live one.
